name: volumio-stream-watchdog
description: Keeps your web radio playing: reissues a stopped stream, falls back to a shuffled local playlist, and resumes the stream when it returns.
author: josemathias

volumio_info.details: Watches your web radio and keeps it playing. Every few seconds it checks what the player — and the sound card — is actually doing: if the stream has stopped, it reissues it; if that does not help, it switches to a curated local Volumio playlist, always shuffled; while the playlist plays it checks the stream and resumes it as soon as it is back. Because it looks at the player itself instead of waiting for events, a stream that fails to restart after an outage cannot go unnoticed.
volumio_info.changelog: 2.1.2 — Fixes a second way of taking the plugin's own offline playlist for the user's choice (2026-11-05: the radio came back over a Volumio queue still holding the offline tracks, and the plugin stopped watching): the queued tracks are remembered for as long as they sit in Volumio's queue. The plugin now sends at most one command every 10 s, so the offline playlist starts about 25 s after a stream stops (was 15 s). 2.1.1 — Fixes a field regression of 2.1.0: the offline playlist the plugin queued is never taken for the user's choice ('WATCHING → FALLBACK (the offline playlist is playing)'), and for 10 s after queueing it the stream it replaces is not taken for the stream coming back; MPD playing silence counts only after 20 s, so short network hiccups are left to MPD. 2.1.0 — Also checks the sound card: when Volumio says play but the card is not playing, the stream is reissued and, if that fails, the offline playlist plays. New log lines: 'Sound card idle while Volumio says play (…)', 'Sound card not checked — using Volumio's state only (…)', 'Sound card checked again (…)'; reissues for this cause read 'Reissuing stream (the sound card is not playing)'. Also reads MPD's log: when the stream's connection stalls and MPD plays silence ('Decoder is too slow'), the stream is reissued — shorter hiccups are left to MPD ('MPD playing silence while Volumio says play (…)', 'Reissuing stream (MPD is playing silence)'; 'MPD log not checked (…)' when the log cannot be read). Only buttons pressed in the Volumio UI (Stop, Pause; Next/Back on the radio) count as the user's intent — the same commands from the REST API or CLI (remotes, scripts) are undone; a pause nobody pressed is treated as a stop ('Reissuing stream (the player is paused)'); Volumio stuck on pause while the card plays is adopted. The user-stop log line is now '→ IDLE (<stop|pause|next|prev> pressed in the Volumio UI)'. 2.0.0 — Rewritten as a single check loop, so no recovery step can wait forever; the offline playlist is always shuffled, first track included; restore tries that fail back off up to 10 min
